fix_summary: Removed the caller-attested-incentive-value antipattern (amount_fact_key="cz_incentive_value_czk"/amount_fact_max rejection condition) from both live-action and animation tiers; added a genuine IncentiveValueCapRule (CZK 450,000,000, sourced 2026-07-13 CZK/USD=21.238 FX snapshot) consumed by allocation_pricing._resolve_incentive_dollar_cap, applied AFTER rate resolution to REDUCE the calculated incentive rather than reject the candidate. The pre-existing 80%-of-eligible-budget QpeCapRule is unchanged and continues to bind correctly on its own real per-candidate gross_budget_usd.

fr-vfx-threshold condition changed from a hard-coded USD proxy (amount_fact_key="fr_trip_vfx_spend_usd"/amount_fact_min=2,281,047.91 derived from a fixed conversion) to a genuine native-EUR fact (amount_fact_key="fr_trip_vfx_spend_eur"/amount_fact_min=2,000,000.0, evaluated with zero conversion since the fact and the statutory threshold are already the same currency).

ma-min-shooting-days changed from a boolean label (required_boolean_fact_key="ma_ccm_18_shooting_days_confirmed") to a genuine numeric fact (amount_fact_key="ma_ccm_shooting_days_count"/amount_fact_min=18.0), proving the real 17/18-day statutory boundary. Added a NEW, separate ma-prior-approval-fund-availability boolean condition (required_boolean_fact_key="ma_ccm_prior_approval_and_fund_availability_confirmed") that was previously absent entirely.

Replaced the fixed baked-in USD substitute (amount_fact_key="mt_mfc_qualifying_spend_eur"/amount_fact_min=50,000.0, itself a caller-attested new fact never supplied by real projects) with a new RateCondition.fx_native_currency="EUR"/fx_native_threshold_amount=50,000.0 mechanism: the segment's OWN qpe_usd is converted to EUR DYNAMICALLY at resolution time via the real, dated, sourced FX snapshot (never a fixed number baked in ahead of time), restoring Codex's own required "Candidate prices base" auto-pricing behavior from real project QPE. Added a genuinely-executable mt-uplift-certificate boolean gate (required_boolean_fact_key="mt_mfc_uplift_certificate_confirmed") to BOTH the general and animation 40% ceiling tiers (the animation ceiling previously had NO gating mechanism at all).

Reconciled the already-accepted EUR 3,000,000 per-company cap (program_requirements.py ProgramRequirementsProfile, never previously wired to the executable rate-rule layer -- no new research) into a new IncentiveValueCapRule consumed by allocation_pricing._resolve_incentive_dollar_cap, applied AFTER rate resolution to REDUCE an over-cap calculated incentive rather than reject the candidate.

Complete rewrite from a flat, UNCONDITIONED 15% floor + one boolean unlocking a 30% ceiling (with a fabricated, unsourced USD $1.4m proxy) to the real, already-accepted TFO Incentive Measures Guidelines 2025 structure reconciled from program_requirements.py: a shared preapproval boolean gate (required_boolean_fact_key="th_film_incentive_preapproval_confirmed") plus three genuinely OBJECTIVE native-THB spend tiers (15% from THB 50m, 20% for THB 100-150m, 25% above THB 150m via amount_fact_key="th_film_incentive_qualifying_spend_thb"), and a +5% discretionary Soft Power uplift to 30% that remains genuinely non-self-executing (kind="discretionary_band"). This is the single program whose fix changes FVD's/Little Utopia's/Bad Hombres'/Lips Like Sugar's real candidate universe -- see GLOBAL_PROGRAM_CANDIDATE_UNIVERSE_DELTA_CLAUDE.csv.

Reconciled against this codebase's own established veto-lifting standard (authority_coverage_registry.py's own module docstring: a citation is promotable off UNPRICEABLE_AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT only when fetched directly from the administering government's own page AND quotes specific statutory/regulatory rate language). us_or_opif's real citation explicitly states the primary oregonfilm.org page confirmed general structure but NOT the exact figures on direct fetch -- secondary/aggregator sources (wrapbook.com) are the only source for the exact numbers. The veto is correctly justified and stays; the flagged synthetic-copied-slug test antipattern was replaced with a test proving the veto's justification directly against the real citation text and the component-basis rate model directly against the real, un-copied us_or_opif RateRule objects. No new research performed to lift a genuinely insufficient authority.

Replaced the vague single boolean ("us_tx_miip_resident_threshold_met") with the real, already-accepted, primary-sourced structured facts (program_requirements.py's additional_facts["texas_resident_requirement"]): two independent numeric gates (amount_fact_key="us_tx_miip_resident_crew_pct"/"us_tx_miip_resident_cast_pct", both amount_fact_min=35.0) plus a separate us-tx-pool-period-valid boolean (required_boolean_fact_key="us_tx_miip_pool_period_valid"), alongside the pre-existing us-tx-award-allocation-required gate -- all four gates_tier_eligibility=False (lone floorless ceiling). Also fixed a real, previously-latent bug in allocation_pricing.py's floorless-ceiling guard: it only checked `satisfied is None`, never a genuine `satisfied is False` -- a numeric gate like resident-crew-pct CAN evaluate to a definite False, which the old check let through as if unresolved. Fixed to `satisfied is not True` in both occurrences.

Removed the caller-attested-incentive-value antipattern (amount_fact_key="za_nfvf_incentive_value_zar"/amount_fact_max rejection condition) from both tiers; added a genuine IncentiveValueCapRule (ZAR 25,000,000, sourced 2026-07-13 ZAR/USD=16.3636 FX snapshot) applied AFTER rate resolution to REDUCE the calculated incentive rather than reject the candidate. Added a NEW distinct za-nfvf-post-only-25 tier (its own za-nfvf-post-only-gate boolean, required_boolean_fact_key="za_nfvf_post_production_only_confirmed") that independently unlocks the same 25% base for the previously entirely-unmodeled post-production-only branch.
